INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

7. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
